title: Hadamard Flattening and Gaussian Pooling Sketch for Least Squares with Coordinate-wise Guarantee
abstract: arXiv:2608.26552v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Randomized sketch-and-solve algorithms accelerate overconstrained $\ell_2$ regression by replacing the input with a smaller problem. Standard subspace embeddings guarantee that the cost of the regression is nearly preserved, but coordinate-wise accuracy of the solution is more delicate: we want the solution vector itself to be close to the optimal solution in $\ell_\infty$ norm. In particular, we want to find a vector $x'\in \mathbb{R}^d$ such that $\|x'-x^*\|_\infty\leq \frac{\epsilon}{\sqrt d}\cdot \|Ax^\star-b\|_2\cdot \|A^\dagger\|_{\rm op}$. Price, Song and Woodruff initiated the study of this problem and showed that the subsampled randomized Hadamard transform (SRHT) with $O(\epsilon^{-2} d^{1+\Theta(\sqrt{\log\log n/\log d})})$ rows achieves this guarantee. A subsequent work of Song, Ye, Yin and Zhang claimed to improve the row count to $O(\epsilon^{-2}d\log^3 n)$. Unfortunately, their proof relies on an independence assumption

translated_title: 哈达玛展平与高斯池化草图用于具有坐标级保证的最小二乘问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26552v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：随机化草图-求解算法通过将输入替换为更小的问题来加速过约束的$\ell_2$回归。标准子空间嵌入保证回归成本几乎被保留，但解的坐标级准确性更为微妙：我们希望解向量本身在$\ell_\infty$范数下接近最优解。特别是，我们希望找到一个向量$x'\in \mathbb{R}^d$，使得$\|x'-x^*\|_\infty\leq \frac{\epsilon}{\sqrt d}\cdot \|Ax^\star-b\|_2\cdot \|A^\dagger\|_{\rm op}$。Price、Song和Woodruff率先研究了这个问题，并表明使用$O(\epsilon^{-2} d^{1+\Theta(\sqrt{\log\log n/\log d})})$行的子采样随机哈达玛变换（SRHT）可以实现这一保证。Song、Ye、Yin和Zhang的后续工作声称将行数改进为$O(\epsilon^{-2}d\log^3 n)$。不幸的是，他们的证明依赖于一个独立性假设。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合哈达玛展平和高斯池化的新草图方法，用于解决最小二乘问题，并在坐标级精度上提供了更优的保证，同时指出了先前工作证明中的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel sketching method combining Hadamard flattening and Gaussian pooling for least squares problems, offering improved coordinate-wise guarantees and identifying a flaw in previous work's proof.
